messages:
Priya: heads up — getting multiple customer reports about failed uploads and timeouts hitting /v1/tokenize in prod. The monitoring alert (tokenizer-error-rate) fired at ~10:02 but nobody got paged :

incident-bot: ALERT triggered: tokenizer-error-rate > 5% for 3m. Attempting to page on-call. pagerduty webhook response: 422 Unprocessable Entity

Rohan: wait 422 from PD webhook? can you paste the webhook response?

incident-bot: payload send failed. PD response body: '{\"error\":\"invalid signature\"}'

Maya: digging into the ingress logs — seeing weird bytes in alert title when we build the PD payload. looks like some multi-byte emoji / non-utf8 fragments slipped into the alert_summary. sample: 
```
alert_summary=Tokenize failure \xf0\x9f\x98\x8e user_id=...
signature_payload=base_string_with_multibyte
```

Maya: PD HMAC verification is rejecting the request because our signing code truncates the UTF-8 sequence when computing the base string. reproducing locally.

Carlos: ok manual mitigation: I just paged the oncall via PD UI and called the oncall. oncall is enroute. @Rohan can you open a hotfix PR to sanitize alert text before signing?

Rohan: yep. small change to ensure we normalize to NFC and drop invalid bytes before signing. will push patch and create canary deploy to alert-proxy.

Priya: ops: start the fallback routing for tokenizer to v2-fallback for affected tenants? reduce retries? customers seeing 5xx.

Carlos: I flipped the router to route ~30% to v2-fallback and lowered client timeout to 3s. customer support notified.

Maya: pushed a temp regex sanitizer to strip non-printables in the webhook payload and re-sent the alert — PD accepted it (200). incident-bot then sent ephemeral message that the page succeeded.

incident-bot: PAGE SENT to pagerduty:incident-service (incident #INC-5402). ack pending.

Priya: good. can we confirm customer impact window and list tenants impacted?

Maya: initial census: 14 tenants with >3% error rate between 10:00–10:12. I exported a CSV to S3: s3://redwood-ops/incidents/1742001234-tokenizer-impact.csv

Carlos: Ops timeline for retro: - 10:02 alert fired, bot failed to page due to signature error - 10:05 manual page & call - 10:08 fallback routing enabled - 10:09 webhook sanitizer deployed - 10:11 PD page delivered & oncall acknowledged - 10:20 error rates falling.

Rohan: PR: github.com/redwood/alert-proxy/pull/1189 — includes NFC normalize + tests for multibyte payload signing. Requesting quick review from @Maya @Carlos.

Priya: thanks everyone. action items: Rohan deploy hotfix, Maya follow up to confirm no other alert channels affected, Carlos draft customer message (postmortem note), Priya own retro. tagging for postmortem. :spiral_notepad: :thumbsup:
